title: "Altair concatenation"
output:

    self_contained: false

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
```

```{r unrelated-output, echo=FALSE}
# An unrelated empty div must not count as a chart container.
knitr::raw_html('<div id="unrelated-output"></div>')
```

```{python first}
import altair as alt

chart = alt.Chart(alt.Data(values=[{"x": 1, "y": 2}])).mark_point().encode(
    x="x:Q", y="y:Q"
)
concatenated = alt.concat(chart, chart)
# Each output in this chunk needs its own container ID.
concatenated
concatenated
```

```{python second}
concatenated
```
